About Team

Creative Researchers: material, audiovisual, and digital

With backgrounds in film and photography, we examine issues of sustainability and community. Through stone and metal sculpting, we explore heritage and craft. Technology offers a deeper bridge between these worlds. By embracing a cross-disciplinary approach, through a methodology that combines these three areas, we conduct research that equips us to address the challenges involved in reckoning contemporary technologies with heritage-rich tools.

We offer active participatory workshops as a human-centred approach to knowledge sharing.
